title: Thesis: Handling Missing Data in Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A Master's thesis project in statistical data analysis that studies strategies for handling missing data (CCA, MI, indicator method) in synthetic data generation and their downstream effect on predictive model performance. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, driven through sdv.metadata.Metadata, to train CTGAN models and generate the synthetic datasets used in the simulation study.
